Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4161, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney (seat .claude-bob); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. This is a SAFETY-tier review, because the PR changes posted G-code (the Klartext arc check).

### What looks good

- The default limit is 0.016 mm. The Klartext post accepts only the Fehlmann Picomax 55 with iTNC 530 NC 340490-03 (#4114). Issue #4086 records MP 7431 = 0.016 mm for this machine. Thus the default is equal to the limit of the one machine that the post accepts.
- A stated tolerance above 0.016 mm (the MP 7431 maximum) is refused by name.
- The refusal names the start radius, the end radius and the limit, as the issue asks.
- `limits_sane` refuses a stated `arc_tolerance` that is zero, negative or not finite at the app door (`LoadMachine`, `setup_mount`).
- The new tests go into the existing `script_heidenhain_klartext` suite as a submodule. No new test binary.
- No golden or recorded program changed. The Klartext goldens and the catalog suites stay green.

### Results, merged with upstream/main 12ea01a (local, macOS)

- Pinning tests, `script_heidenhain_klartext::arc_tests::*`: 4 of 4 pass.
- Full suite `post script_heidenhain_klartext`: 27 pass.
- Quick gate `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 216 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (11.1 min). This includes `post lib`, every post suite in the plan, `app:klartext_builtin`, `app:bore_cycle`, `app:conformance`, `app:first_part_programs` and the catalog suites.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane: not run. Its six steps are motion and pocket generation twins (`gate light --dry-run`). This diff touches only `camcraft-post` and one post script, and it does not get to them.
- Heavy lanes: not run. This is a P3 PR, and no heavy step is necessary (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review").

### Extra suites run

- `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `first_part_programs`: all pass, in the quick plan. The diff touches `assets/posts/`.
- TEST DATA: the diff changes no `testdata/` file. IMPORTERS: the diff changes no import code.

### Mutations (made locally, then reverted)

1. Default limit set back to 0.0001 mm in `onCircular`: RED. `arc_with_radius_difference_of_0_0003_mm_after_rounding_posts` and `arc_with_radius_difference_above_machine_tolerance_is_refused_with_radii_and_limit` fail.
2. `arcTolerance` removed from the mirror (`crates/post/src/post/machine.rs`): RED. `custom_machine_arc_tolerance_is_respected_and_named_in_refusal` and `arc_tolerance_above_controller_maximum_is_refused` fail.
3. `arcTolerance` removed from `script_props` (`machine_installation.rs`): RED. The same two tests fail. The mirror key and the script key are thus both necessary.
4. The refusal in `onOpen` turned off: GREEN. The same refusal in `onCircular` catches the value. See note 2.

### Goldens moved

None. The body does not list goldens, and no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed.

### Optional, non-blocking (follow-ups, P7)

1. A stated tolerance that is not a number (for example `"arc_tolerance": "0.005"`) is ignored, and the post uses 0.016 mm with no note. On the CLI path (`parse_mch` without `is_sane`), a value of zero or a negative value also falls back to 0.016 mm with no note. This cannot post an arc above the limit of the one accepted machine. But AGENTS.md says that a bad tolerance must give a clean error. Recommended: refuse a stated key that is not a positive finite number, by name, in `parse_mch` (`crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs:224`), and in the script when the key is present but not valid.
2. The script reads the tolerance in two places (`assets/posts/heidenhain-klartext.cps:94-101` and `:308-315`). `onOpen` refuses first, so the second `> 0.016` refusal in `onCircular` cannot occur. Recommended: read the value one time in `onOpen` into a global, and use that global in `onCircular`.
3. The script also reads `machine.controller.arcTolerance` (`:96`, `:310`). The flattened `machine` global has no `controller` object, so that branch is not used.
4. The machine file accepts four spellings of the key (`controller.arc_tolerance`, `controller.arcTolerance`, `arc_tolerance`, `arcTolerance`). No other `.mch` key does this. The new key is also not in `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`, where the other `machine.*` globals are given. Recommended: keep one file form (`controller.arc_tolerance`), and add a `machine.arcTolerance` line to the document.
5. `parse.rs` multiplies the value by the kinematics unit factor. The raw-door read in `machine_installation.rs:70-77` does not. An inch machine file through the raw door gets an unscaled value. The Klartext post goes through `parse_mch` for its machine, so this does not change its output now.
6. The issue asks for a check "with a margin". The PR adds `+ 1e-6` above the limit. The posted values are rounded to 4 decimals, so this is correct. A short comment that says this would help the next reader.
7. `crates/post/tests/klartext/arc_tests.rs` has no header line that says what it pins.

### Process

- The title is a conventional commit. The body has the pinning tests, what was not exercised, a `Changelog:` line, and it ends with `Fixes #4086`.
- No process file, UI file, snapshot PNG, dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` change.
- The PR merges cleanly with main (`MERGEABLE`).

Please merge `main` into your branch (do not rebase or force-push), run the targeted tests again and push. If the merge needs no hand edits, the clean review stays valid.

@JSwetz: We merged main into your branch. The new head is ad188cabd. Do not push a rebase or a force-push to this branch. The merge needed a hand edit in one file. Thus the clean review of the earlier head does not apply to this head. The new head waits for a delta review of the conflict resolution.

Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4161, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney (seat .claude-bob); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: clean (delta review).** The hand-resolved merge keeps the two sides. No blockers.

### Scope

This is a DELTA review. The last clean collaborator review is on head `6afa294ad`. After that review, the only commit is the merge `ad188cabd` (a merge of `main` 498382c8e, with one conflict resolved by hand). I reviewed only `git show --remerge-diff ad188cab`. The earlier review stays valid for all other code.

### Remerge-diff check

- One hunk only: `crates/post/src/post/machine_installation.rs`, `script_props`.
- Each side added one block after the `toolChangeMode` block:
  - this PR: the `arcTolerance` block (#4086);
  - `main`: the `dNumber` block (#4143).
- The resolution keeps the two blocks in full: first `arcTolerance`, then `dNumber`. The closing brace of the `arcTolerance` block is restored. No other line changed.
- The PR patch against the new `main` parent (`git diff ad188cab^2 ad188cab`) has the same 7 files and the same line counts as the patch of `6afa294ad` against its old base (101 insertions, 4 deletions).

### Results, trial merge of `ad188cabd` with upstream/main `7b2587e15` (local, macOS)

The trial merge has no conflict.

- `post script_heidenhain_klartext`: 27 pass (includes the 4 pinning tests `arc_tests::*`).
- `post heidenhain_cycles` 17 pass, `post post_engine` 33 pass, `post machine_controller` 5 pass, `post machine_check` 5 pass.
- `app sinumerik_safe_retract` (pins the `dNumber` side of the hunk): 7 pass.
- `app klartext_builtin`: 3 pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes and the light lane: not run. This is a P3 PR, and the delta is one hunk in `script_props` ("Heavy lanes at review").

### Extra suites run

- `app example_catalog`: 44 pass, 4 ignored. The PR touches `assets/posts/`.
- TEST DATA: the delta changes no `testdata/` file. IMPORTERS: the delta changes no import code.

### Mutations (made locally, then reverted; the tree is clean)

This is a SAFETY-tier PR (posted G-code). Each mutation removes one side of the resolved hunk.

1. `props["arcTolerance"]` assignment removed: RED. `custom_machine_arc_tolerance_is_respected_and_named_in_refusal` and `arc_tolerance_above_controller_maximum_is_refused` fail.
2. `props["dNumber"]` assignment removed: RED. `a_machine_stating_tool_number_d_writes_d_equal_to_t` (`app sinumerik_safe_retract`) fails.

Thus a test pins each side of the resolution.

### Goldens moved

None. The merge changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file of this PR.

### Earlier findings

The review of `6afa294ad` had no blockers. Its seven optional items stay optional and non-blocking (follow-ups, P7).

### Process

- The merge is a merge commit, not a rebase or a force-push.
- No process file, UI file, snapshot PNG, dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` change in the delta.
- The PR merges cleanly with `main` (`MERGEABLE`). The `conflicts` label is removed.
